title: epan/dissectors/packet-nvme.c:Support NVMe TP 8014
description:
1. Add a subtype for "Current Discovery Subsystem"
2. Decode entry flags
3. Ensure that all discovery log entries are processed.
   When the host issues a get log page for discovery log page with
   log page offset 0, the last (4th) log entry in the response was not
   decoded due to an error in the conditional expression.
   When the host issues a get log page for the discovery log page with
   log page offset != 0, only the first log entry in the response was
   decoded.

commits_data.title: epan/dissectors/packet-nvme.c:Support NVMe TP 8014
commits_data.message:
epan/dissectors/packet-nvme.c:Support NVMe TP 8014

1. Add a subtype for "Current Discovery Subsystem"
2. Decode entry flags
3. Ensure that all discovery log entries are processed.
   When the host issues a get log page for discovery log page with
   log page offset 0, the last (4th) log entry in the response was not
   decoded due to an error in the conditional expression.
   When the host issues a get log page for the discovery log page with
   log page offset != 0, only the first log entry in the response was
   decoded.
4. Fixed offset in decoding discovery log entry records.

Signed-off-by: Vasuki Manikarnike <vasuki.manikarnike@hpe.com>
